name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script per the docs, and successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file from text using the Text-to-Speech API. The output.mp3 file (41,839 bytes) was created and verified as a genuine MPEG ADTS layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, matching the requested mp3_44100_128 output format. The API key was already available in the environment as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
deviations: The quickstart's `play(audio)` step expects speakers to hear audio output, but the sandbox has no audio hardware. To verify the promised outcome (generating an audio file from text), I created a separate verification script that saves the audio stream to output.mp3 and confirms it is a valid MP3 file. The original example.py ran successfully (exit=0), meaning the API call worked, but audio playback was not possible in this headless environment.

env_ready.evidence: cd /home/daytona && pip install elevenlabs python-dotenv" exit=0

verified.evidence: Audio file generated: output.mp3 (41839 bytes) / Valid MP3 file detected (ID3 tag present)
